svg.title: Showers preview and live publication branches
svg.desc: The embedding guide provides a complete text walkthrough of this flow.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Owner confirms an action
Flush latest draft; validate source + revision

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PREVIEW
Reset preview branch to validated live head

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PUBLISH
Use current validated live head

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Client workflow builds again
PREVIEW=1; base /_preview/

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Client workflow builds again
PREVIEW=0; base /
